body:
Parent issue: #170

Stage: simplified-self-merge-main

## Task

Implement a new simplified self-merge PR against main. Context: most self-approval changes have now landed on main; prior PR #202 was too complicated, and the requester points to https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/202#issuecomment-4417668475 as the desired simplification direction. Use the simpler product rule: after agent self-approval has approved the current PR head and checks/mergeability pass with no requested changes, self-merge should merge the PR into its configured base. Keep only the core safeguards: AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE remains opt-in and false by default; require trusted current-head Sepo self-approval; require no blocking requested changes; preserve check and mergeability handling; bind final merge/auto-merge commands with --match-head-commit. Avoid the over-conservative guardrails from #202: do not require default-branch-only bases, do not add complex stack-base lookup, and do not block draft agent PRs solely for draft status; mark draft PRs ready before merge when needed. Keep implementation small and focused: typed deterministic helper/CLI logic over workflow shell, minimal workflow plumbing, focused tests for the core merge path and race guard, and concise docs/config updates. Do not revive or retarget closed PRs #202 or #214 as the implementation artifact.

## Base

- base_branch: main
